newsitem.title: USA: Salomon stake cut by Dart to less than 5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Salomon stake cut by Dart to less than 5 pct.

text.p: Dart Financial Group said on Thursday it cut its stake in Salomon Inc to slightly less than 5 percent, or 5,357,100 common shares.

In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Dart said its latest transactions in the stock included the sale of shares between February 13 and August 6 at prices ranging from $55 a share to $65.25 a share.

Dart Financial is a private trust company affiliated with Dart Container Corp, a Mason, Mich.-based maker of polystyrene cups, plastic cutlery and dinnerware. The latest transactions were made through Ross Financial Corp, a Dart affiliate.
